proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Improve Shareholder Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to enable holders of 10% of shares to request a record date to initiate shareholder written consent, lowering the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: WE RECOMMEND THAT YOU VOTE "AGAINST" THE ADOPTION OF THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Request for Board of Directors to Adopt Policy for an Independent Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy requiring separation of the Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman to be independent whenever possible and not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: WE RECOMMEND THAT YOU VOTE "AGAINST" THE ADOPTION OF THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: POLITICAL SPENDING MISALIGNMENT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures are congruent with publicly stated company values and policies, and actions taken as a result.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Rescission of 2022 Racial Equity Audit Proposal
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks shareholders to commit to rescinding the 2022 racial equity audit proposal and to reject racially discriminatory practices at the company.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Senior Management Commitment to Avoid Political Speech
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to encourage a senior management commitment to avoid public positions on controversial social or political issues unless justified by business strategy.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.
